selected_response.description: The SZ_INCLUDE_MATCH_KEY_DETAILS flag is dependent on using one of the following flags: SZ_ENTITY_INCLUDE_ALL_RELATIONS , SZ_ENTITY_INCLUDE_POSSIBLY_SAME_RELATIONS , SZ_ENTITY_INCLUDE_POSSIBLY_RELATED_RELATIONS , SZ_ENTITY_INCLUDE_NAME_ONLY_RELATIONS , or SZ_ENTITY_INCLUDE_DISCLOSED_RELATIONS. When the SZ_INCLUDE_MATCH_KEY_DETAILS flag is used, each related entity includes a MATCH_KEY_DETAILS object containing CONFIRMATIONS (and optionally DENIALS) arrays. Each entry describes the specific feature comparison that contributed to or denied the relationship, including scores and score buckets.
selected_response.name: SZ_INCLUDE_MATCH_KEY_DETAILS
